title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Azure) at Proxify
description_review: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer role at Proxify focusing on Azure infrastructure reliability, security, and scalability. Involves Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, IaC, and scripting (PowerShell, Bash). Fully remote position for CET (+/- 3 hours) timezone.
pros: Senior role handling cloud architecture and container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes)
cons: Pure DevOps and cloud infrastructure engineering role, weak fit per candidate guidelines
No Java, Spring Boot, microservices backend development, or application code ownership
Requires dedicated focus on Azure VMs, App Services, and infrastructure automation

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (React.js / Node.js) at Proxify
description_review: Senior Fullstack Developer role at Proxify designing low-latency systems and reusable libraries with Node.js and React.js. Stack covers microservices architecture, SQL, and MongoDB. Remote engagement requiring CET (+/- 3 hours) availability.
pros: Senior fullstack scope (5+ years) with strong emphasis on microservices architecture and backend systems
Experience matches with SQL, MongoDB, and TypeScript/frontend ecosystem
cons: Node.js and React.js stack rather than Java and Spring Boot backend
No enterprise legacy modernization or AI agent components mentioned
Contractor talent-network model rather than core product engineering role

title: Senior Python Developer (Fullstack, BE-Heavy) at Proxify
description_review: Senior Backend-Heavy Python Fullstack Developer role at Proxify acting as core software architect. Responsibilities include high-throughput backend scaling, asynchronous API design, and client-side UI delivery. Full-time remote within CET (+/- 3 hours).
pros: Senior software architect scope with 5+ years building high-throughput backend systems and APIs
cons: Python-heavy role without AI/agent focus, weak fit per candidate profile guidance
No Java, Spring Boot, or microservices architecture in the core description
Client-matching network engagement rather than direct product team

title: Senior Django Developer at Proxify
description_review: Senior Django Developer role at Proxify requiring 4+ years specializing in Django, Django ORM, and Django REST framework. Involves event-driven programming, multi-process architecture, and multi-database integration. Fully remote in CET (+/- 3 hours).
pros: Senior backend architectural experience with REST APIs and event-driven patterns
cons: Strict specialization in Python/Django and Jinja/Mako templating
No Java, Spring Boot, or enterprise microservices stack

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (.NET) at Proxify

pros: Senior full-stack architectural scope owning backend services and APIs

cons: Primary focus on C# / ASP.NET Core and .NET-driven UIs rather than Java/Spring Boot
